Cavaliers 115Knicks 107

Harden's season-high 32 beats the Knicks

Final · Wed, Nov 11 · New York

James Harden scored a season-high 32. Cleveland wins at the Garden.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Cavaliers led 33–23 after one quarter. At the half, the Cavaliers led 59–53.

2 of 5 · The difference

Harden: a season-high 32 points

He came in averaging 15.3. Then 5 of 7 from three.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the first quarter 33–23

From the opening tip, the Cavaliers won the first quarter 33–23 to lead 33–23. Harden and Mitchell combined for 55 of 115.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it at the line and on the glass

Free throws made 20–11; rebounds 50–42. Jalen Brunson didn’t take a free throw.

5 of 5 · Final

Cavaliers 115, Knicks 107.

From the Knicks’ side: Lost the first quarter 23–33, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Cavaliers 6–6, 6th in the East, 64% top-6 odds. Knicks 6–5, 5th in the East, 61%.
